reading: A judge in Massachusetts has declared a mistrial in the Lindsay Clancy murder case.
The jury could not agree after a week of discussions following weeks of testimony.
The case concerns the deaths of her three children.
Her lawyer tried unsuccessfully to prevent the mistrial.
Another hearing is scheduled for later in the month to consider the next steps.
The prosecutor said the legal team would discuss whether to seek another trial.
Clancy remains held on the existing charges.
